data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Francisco holds special spiritual significance due to its association with St. Francis of Assisi. Born in Italy in 1112, St. Francis is known for his deep devotion to God and his radical attachment to poverty and nature. His legacy includes founding the Franciscan Order, which is dedicated to living in poverty, and his work helping the sick, the poor, and the marginalized. The name Francisco is a reminder of the Christian call to follow in the footsteps of St. Francis, to embrace the simplicity and humility of the Gospel, and to uplift the most vulnerable among us.

He was the youngest son of the Duke of Gandia. Borja joined the Society of Jesus in 1535, and was instrumental in the early development of the Jesuit order, which played a crucial role in the Counter-Reformation. He was appointed the fourth General of the Society of Jesus in 1565.

Francisco de Miranda, a Venezuelan military leader, politician, and revolutionary, was born on February 25, 1750, in Cumaná, Venezuela. He was a key figure in the early Venezuela independence movement, and was the first commander-in-chief of the Venezuelan army. He is considered the 'Father of Venezuelan Independence'. He died in exile in France in 1816.
